title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening and Innovating Environmental and Resource Adjudication in the New Era to Provide Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Modernization of Harmony between Humanity and Nature
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Strengthening and Innovating Environmental Resources Adjudication in the New Era to Provide Judicial Services and Safeguards for Building a Modernization Where Humans and Nature Coexist in Harmony

Fa Fa [2021] No. 28

To thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, promote the comprehensive implementation of the Outline of the 14th Five-Year Plan, give full play to the adjudicative functions of people's courts, and provide fair and efficient judicial services and safeguards for building an ecological civilization system in the new era and a modernization where humans and nature coexist in harmony, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Strengthen Political Guidance, Grasp the Direction of Environmental Resources Adjudication in the New Era

1. Adhere to the Guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law. Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law are the fundamental guidelines and scientific guidelines for promoting the modernization of the national environmental governance system and governance capacity. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over environmental resources adjudication, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," achieve the "Two Upholds," and keep in mind the "Great Matters of the Nation." They must firmly establish a people-centered development philosophy, strive to meet the growing needs of the people for a beautiful ecological environment. They must vigorously promote the Saihanba spirit of staying true to the mission, working hard, and green development, deeply practice the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, strictly observe the value norms of respecting, conforming to, and protecting nature, follow the systematic concept of integrated protection of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands, deserts, and ice, and protect the ecological environment with the strictest systems and the most rigorous rule of law. With an international vision of jointly seeking global ecological environmental governance, coordinate domestic rule of law and foreign-related rule of law, and promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind and a clean and beautiful world.

2. Grasp the Development Goals of Environmental Resources Adjudication in the New Era. People's courts at all levels must accurately grasp the new development stage, thoroughly implement the new development concept, accelerate the construction of a new development pattern, and promote environmental resources adjudication to open up new chapters and new prospects in the new era. Focusing on the overall goal of building an ecological environment judicial protection system with Chinese characteristics and international influence, with greater determination, clearer thinking, and more precise measures, comprehensively strengthen and innovate all aspects of environmental resources adjudication, strive to promote the opening up of new environmental judicial concepts in the new era, achieve new improvements in adjudication quality and efficiency, take new steps in reform and innovation, achieve new results in specialized construction, achieve new progress in service and safeguard capabilities, and reach new heights in international influence.

3. Identify the Entry Points and Focus Points of Strengthening and Innovating Environmental Resources Adjudication in the New Era. People's courts at all levels must focus on strengthening the construction of environmental judicial capacity, improve case adjudication rules, and enhance adjudication quality and efficiency. Focus on institutional and mechanism construction, build a large pattern of coordinated adjudication of criminal, civil, and administrative environmental resources cases as well as case filing and enforcement, improve preventive and restorative judicial measures, perfect the public interest litigation system, and enrich diversified dispute resolution methods. Fully implement the green principles and green clauses of the Civil Code, and promote the transformation of rules in the adjudication of specific cases. Use the cultivation and promotion of high-quality cases as a starting point to fully leverage the guiding role of cases in rules and values. Rely on information technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, and blockchain to promote the deep integration of information technology and environmental justice. Continuously deepen international environmental judicial exchanges, and strive to enhance the international discourse power and rule guidance power of environmental justice.

II. Adhere to a People-Centered Approach, Effectively Solve Prominent Ecological and Environmental Problems Around the People

4. Assist in Deepening the Fight Against Pollution. Increase the severity of punishment for environmental pollution crimes, severely crack down on prominent illegal and criminal activities such as secret pipe discharge, cross-regional dumping, smuggling of waste, fraud in emission monitoring data, and dereliction of duty in environmental supervision. Adjudicate civil cases involving air, water, soil, solid waste, and new pollutants in accordance with the law, effectively safeguard the personal, property, and environmental rights and interests of the people. Adjudicate cases involving hazardous waste and medical waste disposal in accordance with the law, focus on resolving conflicts and disputes arising from the closure, transfer, or transformation of hazardous chemical production enterprises in key areas. Adjudicate cases involving environmental impact assessment in accordance with the law, promote the effective exertion of the function and role of environmental impact assessment in preventing environmental risks.

5. Promote Continuous Improvement of Urban Living Environment. Adjudicate cases involving the remediation of urban black and odorous water bodies in accordance with the law, severely punish illegal and criminal activities such as discharging pollutants into urban rivers, lakes, and bays. Adjudicate cases involving soil pollution of construction land in accordance with the law, promote risk control and remediation of polluted construction land, and strengthen accountability. Properly handle disputes arising from the site selection and construction of facilities such as sewage and garbage treatment stations, prevent secondary pollution from environmental protection facilities, and achieve an organic balance between the objective needs of pollutant treatment and the high-quality living environment requirements of surrounding residents. Adjudicate cases involving the renovation of urban villages, shanty towns, and old residential communities, urban garbage classification, and ecological landscape construction in accordance with the law, promote the construction of green cities, forest cities, and "zero-waste cities."

6. Serve the Construction of Ecologically Livable Beautiful Villages. Legally punish illegal and criminal acts of occupying and polluting farmland and fishery waters, ensuring the safety of grain supply and important agricultural products. Adjudicate cases involving the prevention and control of agricultural non-point source pollution in accordance with the law, improve the level of harmless disposal and resource utilization of agricultural waste such as livestock and poultry manure, crop straw, agricultural film, and aquatic by-products, assist in carrying out village cleaning and greening actions. Adjudicate cases involving the protection of traditional houses, ancient villages, and ancient buildings in accordance with the law, enhance the judicial protection level of rural natural and cultural landscapes, assist in building beautiful villages "where mountains can be seen, waters can be seen, and nostalgia can be remembered."

III. Implement Systematic Concepts, Promote the Construction of a Community of Life Between Humans and Nature

7. Strengthen Comprehensive Protection of Ecosystems. Legally punish illegal and criminal activities that damage the ecology, such as illegal mining and sand quarrying, illegal occupation of rivers and lakes, indiscriminate logging, deforestation and grass digging, and illegal reclamation. Adjudicate cases involving ecological protection measures such as farmland fallow rotation, enclosure protection, ecological migration, and stall feeding in accordance with the law, promote the recuperation of grasslands and forests. Increase protection efforts for mountains, lakes, and wetlands, adjudicate cases involving the conversion of farmland to forests and wetlands, wetland protection and restoration projects, and wetland use control in accordance with the law, promote the effective exertion of wetland functions such as water source protection, flood storage and regulation, pollution control, and climate regulation. Adjudicate cases involving coastal and marine engineering construction projects, island resource development and utilization, mariculture, and sea reclamation for farming in accordance with the law, promote the establishment of a land-sea coordinated marine ecological environmental protection and restoration system, and maintain the natural reproductive capacity of the ocean.

8. Effectively Maintain Biodiversity. Severely crack down on various criminal activities that damage wildlife resources. Legally punish illegal and criminal acts such as illegal trade of wildlife and their products using the internet or other means, and illegal introduction, release, or disposal of alien species. Adjudicate cases involving judicial protection of genetic diversity, species diversity, and ecosystem diversity in accordance with the law, adhere to the principles of protection and sustainable use, curb biodiversity loss and ecosystem degradation. Legally protect the ecological environment of habitats of precious and endangered wildlife, escort the safe migration of migratory birds. Adjudicate cases involving liability insurance for wildlife accidents in accordance with the law, ensure the orderly implementation of major biodiversity projects. Coordinate epidemic prevention and control with judicial protection of biodiversity, boost the continuous improvement of national biosafety governance capacity.

9. Assist in Winning the Protracted War of the Ten-Year Fishing Ban in the Yangtze River. Strictly implement the Yangtze River Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, severely crack down on various fishing-related illegal and criminal activities such as "electric fishing, poison fishing, blast fishing" and "extinction fishing nets," legally punish activities such as nest digging for egg collection, sand excavation and stone quarrying, effectively protect precious and endangered wild animals in the Yangtze River. Increase the severity of punishment for the purchase, processing, sale, and utilization of illegal catches, cut off the underground industry chain of illegal fishing from the source and terminal. Support and supervise administrative organs in carrying out administrative law enforcement activities such as "clearing boats" and "clearing nets" in accordance with the law, properly handle disputes arising from the confiscation and disposal of "three-no" vessels and illegal fishing tools, as well as the rectification of aquatic product markets, fishing-related restaurants, and catch markets. Adjudicate cases involving the relocation, transfer, and job transformation of fishermen in accordance with the law, promote the continuous improvement and perfection of the long-term mechanism of the fishing ban, ensure the implementation of the ten-year fishing ban in key waters of the Yangtze River Basin.

10. Promote the Continuous Improvement of the Ecological Environment of the Yellow River Basin. Adhere to the principle of jointly doing a good job in large-scale protection and coordinating the promotion of large-scale governance, effectively protect the ecological environment of the Yellow River Basin. Adjudicate cases involving the protection of important ecosystems such as glaciers in the source area of the Yellow River, plateau permafrost, alpine meadows, grasslands, rivers, and lakes in accordance with the law, enhance the water conservation capacity of the upper reaches of the Yellow River. Adjudicate cases involving environmental pollution in the main stream and important tributaries of the Yellow River in accordance with the law, support and supervise administrative organs in carrying out the construction of the project of converting farmland to forests and grasslands on the Loess Plateau in accordance with the law, assist in the simultaneous improvement of pollution control and soil and water conservation in the Yellow River. Adjudicate cases involving the protection of wetlands in the delta of the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River and the coordination of water-sediment relationships in accordance with the law, maintain river management order, promote the continuous improvement of the ecological environment.

11. Ensure the Construction of a System of Natural Protected Areas. Increase judicial protection efforts for national parks, nature reserves, and various natural parks such as geological parks, forest parks, marine parks, and wetland parks, legally punish illegal and criminal activities such as illegal reclamation, development, or construction of buildings, and discharge of pollutants and dumping of waste within natural protected areas. Strictly distinguish the functional positioning of core protection areas, general control areas, and other areas, properly handle conflicts and disputes arising from development, withdrawal, and transformation that are inconsistent with the regional positioning, effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of indigenous residents and related right holders in natural protected areas. Legally ensure the construction of the Great Wall, the Grand Canal, the Long March, and the Yellow River National Cultural Parks, coordinate the integrated protection of natural relics, cultural relics, and folk culture.

12. Build a Strong Judicial Barrier for Ecological Security. Legally punish illegal and criminal activities such as illegal mining of peat and black soil, serve the construction of a black soil protection system. Ensure the construction of shelterbelt systems such as the Three-North Shelterbelt Forest Program and the construction of national reserve forests, assist in the smooth development of large-scale land greening actions. Deeply implement the concept that ice and snow are also invaluable assets, adjudicate cases involving the protection of the ecological environment of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau in accordance with the law, effectively protect the third pole of the earth. Adjudicate cases involving the restoration and protection of national key ecological function areas such as the Beijing-Tianjin sandstorm source control, the ecological protection and construction of the Three Rivers Source, the ecological protection and comprehensive management of the Qilian Mountains, and the comprehensive management of rocky desertification in karst areas in accordance with the law, increase judicial protection efforts for ecologically extremely fragile areas such as soil erosion, land desertification, rocky desertification, coastal erosion, and sand source loss, maintain the national ecological security pattern.

IV. Boost the Energy Revolution, Promote Green and Low-Carbon Transformation of the Economy and Society

13. Improve the Judicial Protection Level of Natural Resource Property Rights. Adjudicate cases involving the ownership of natural resources such as land, grasslands, mineral deposits, forests, and sea areas in accordance with the law, scientifically delineate the boundaries of ownership and use rights of natural resources, safeguard the rights and interests of owners of natural resource assets owned by the whole people. Improve the connection between administrative mediation and judicial adjudication of disputes over natural resource ownership, serve the construction of a market-oriented and diversified ecological protection compensation mechanism. Legally supervise the approval of franchise rights for natural resources within natural protected areas, coordinate and balance ecological environmental protection with resource conservation and intensive development. Pay attention to the trends of platformization, financialization, and informatization of natural resource transactions, adjudicate relevant cases in accordance with the law, serve the construction of a unified natural resource trading market.

14. Increase Judicial Protection Efforts for Water Resources. Adjudicate cases involving water resource protection in river basins in accordance with the law, severely punish illegal and criminal acts such as damaging water environments and water ecosystems, unauthorized water extraction, excessive water extraction, and destructive water extraction. Strengthen judicial supervision over administrative acts such as water rights confirmation, water extraction permit approval, and water extraction metering supervision, adjudicate cases involving water rights trading in accordance with the law. Properly handle conflicts and disputes arising from the construction of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project and land acquisition and resettlement, ensure the safety of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project, water supply safety, and water quality safety. Actively integrate the judicial protection of water resources into major regional strategies such as the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta, and the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin, provide strong water resource support for the formation of a unified national market and smooth domestic circulation.

15. Assist in Achieving the Goals of Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality. Accurately grasp the economic, public, and ecological attributes of carbon-related rights such as carbon emission rights, carbon sinks, and carbon derivatives, properly handle civil disputes involving confirmation, trading, guarantees, and enforcement in accordance with the law. Support and supervise administrative organs in investigating and punishing illegal acts such as false or concealed reporting of greenhouse gas emission reports by emission units, refusal to fulfill greenhouse gas emission reporting obligations in accordance with the law. Adjudicate carbon-related public interest litigation and ecological environmental damage compensation cases filed by state-specified organs or organizations specified by law in accordance with the law, assist in the formation of a clean, low-carbon, safe, and efficient energy system based on renewable energy sources such as wind energy, solar energy, water energy, nuclear energy, gas energy, and biomass energy. Increase the intensity of adjudication of cases involving energy structure adjustment in key areas such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and surrounding areas, the Fenwei Plain, and the Yangtze River Delta region, strictly implement coordinated governance of pollution reduction and carbon reduction. Adjudicate cases involving illegal production, use, and environmental pollution of controlled ozone-depleting substances in accordance with the law, assist in reducing non-carbon dioxide greenhouse gas emissions, effectively address the global climate change crisis.

16. Serve the Green and Optimized Upgrading of Industrial Structure. Properly handle administrative disputes arising from the planning, construction, and production of high-energy consumption and high-emission enterprises in accordance with the law, support and supervise administrative organs in investigating and punishing illegal acts such as construction without approval and inconsistency between approval and construction in accordance with the law. Increase the intensity of adjudication of cases involving the reform, bankruptcy, and reorganization of high-energy consumption and high-emission enterprises, improve the market exit mechanism. Support and supervise administrative organs in exercising their duties of supervising emission permits in accordance with the law, promote enterprises to discharge pollutants according to permits. Increase judicial protection efforts for green innovation intellectual property rights, encourage clean production, and promote the green transformation of key industries and important fields. Support the use of financial instruments to assist green development, serve the construction of a legal system for green credit policies, promote the improvement of green bond issuance system rules, support insurance institutions in innovating green insurance products and services, and promote the healthy development of the green financial market.

V. Continuously Deepen Reform and Innovation, Improve the Environmental Resources Adjudication System

17. Unify the Application of Law in Environmental Resources Adjudication. Adhere to the strictest system and the most rigorous rule of law, follow the principle of legality and proportionality of crime and punishment, accurately grasp the constituent elements of various environmental resources crimes, correctly identify unit crimes, and prudently apply lighter or mitigated punishment. Implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and severity, properly handle the relationship between development and protection, and strive to achieve the organic unity of political effects, legal effects, social effects, and ecological effects. Strengthen systematic research on the right to use natural resources, improve the unified application of law in adjudicating cases related to natural resources. Accurately grasp the attributes and functions of civil lawsuits, public interest litigation, and ecological environmental damage compensation lawsuits for ecological environmental torts, construct a system of constituent elements of ecological environmental damage liability by type, improve the connection mechanism of different litigation procedures and liability methods. Clarify the scope of application of punitive damages, enrich the methods of liability for ecological environmental restoration, standardize the applicable procedures and conditions of injunctions, explore the establishment of a specialized evidence system for environmental resources cases, and continuously improve adjudication procedures and substantive rules.

18. Strengthen the Construction of Specialized Systems. Adhere to systematically promoting the specialization reform of environmental resources adjudication with forward-looking, overall, strategic, and holistic thinking. Effectively focus on the main responsibilities and main businesses, strengthen the construction of environmental resources tribunals, give full play to the fundamental role of institutions in the construction of specialized systems. Improve the "three-in-one" adjudication model of criminal, civil, and administrative environmental resources cases, ensure the unified implementation of environmental judicial concepts in different types of environmental resources cases. Strengthen work coordination with public security organs, procuratorial organs, and administrative departments for environmental resources, improve supporting measures such as the connection of commission for enforcement in different places, the evaluation of ecological restoration effects, and the management system for environmental restoration funds, establish a national environmental resources adjudication information platform. Establish a system for people's assessors with specialized knowledge to participate in the adjudication of environmental resources cases, fully safeguard the people's right to know, participate, and supervise.

19. Build an Adjudication Team with Excellent Quality. Always prioritize the political construction of the Party, strive to enhance the political judgment, political understanding, and political execution of the team, strengthen the construction of discipline and work style, adhere to the bottom line of integrity and self-discipline, and take on responsibilities and interpret loyalty with concrete actions. Comprehensively strengthen the professional capacity building of the team, increase training efforts, cultivate expert judges who are proficient in both environmental law and relevant economic, social, and environmental science knowledge, and strive to build a professional environmental resources adjudication team that the Party and the people trust, rely on, and can rest assured.

20. Deepen International Environmental Judicial Exchanges. Uphold the principles of fairness, common but differentiated responsibilities and respective capabilities, fair and equitable benefit sharing, the principle of responsibility for damage, and the principle of protection and sustainable use of natural resources, join hands with other countries to strengthen judicial responses to global environmental crises such as climate change and its impacts, biodiversity protection, and pollution prevention. Work together to build a diversified sharing platform for environmental judicial cases and judicial experience, establish a normalized international environmental judicial exchange and mutual visit mechanism, promote mutual learning and sharing. Increase cooperation with countries around the world and international organizations, disseminate the voice of China's environmental justice, tell China's environmental justice stories well, and provide Chinese solutions for global environmental justice.

October 8, 2021
